entities.name: RRCResume message
entities.description: The RRCResume message is sent by the network to resume an RRC connection and includes configuration parameters for the UE.

entities.name: UE unable to comply with configuration
entities.description: Condition where the UE cannot apply (part of) the configuration included in the RRCResume message.

entities.name: Transition to RRC_IDLE
entities.description: Procedure where the UE transitions to RRC_IDLE state as specified in clause 5.3.11 with release cause 'RRC Resume'.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE state
entities.description: RRC state where the UE is not actively connected to the network.

entities.name: No partial configuration application
entities.description: Property stating that if the UE cannot comply with part of the configuration, it does not apply any part of the configuration.

relations.description: The condition of UE being unable to comply with RRCResume configuration triggers the transition to RRC_IDLE procedure.
The transition procedure results in the UE entering RRC_IDLE state.
When UE is unable to comply with part of the configuration, it establishes the property that no part of the configuration is applied.
The RRCResume message is guarded by the condition that UE may be unable to comply with its configuration.
